# @fyit/crouton-three

> TresJS (Three.js for Vue) integration — flexible 3D scenes, a glTF/.glb model viewer, keyboard controls, and a 3D model pages block. Build interactive 3D content and games inside a crouton app.

AI hint: use when app needs 3D rendering, WebGL scenes, glTF/glb model display, or interactive 3D/game experiences

## Components

- `CroutonThreeModelViewer`: glTF/.glb model viewer with orbit controls and auto-rotate; renders a placeholder when no model is set
- `CroutonThreeScene`: TresJS canvas wrapper with camera, lights, optional orbit controls, and a default slot for arbitrary 3D content (meshes, models, game objects)
- `CroutonThreeStarterScene`: Runnable game starter — a WASD / arrow-key controllable cube on a ground plane (uses useThreeControls)

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useThreeControls`
